paragraphs.text: Isareth the Awakener is a legendary human wizard from an unknown plane .

Isareth was a queen and a high priest, a theocrat with unquestioned power. She ruled a sprawling temple-city, living in luxurious splendor, until her subjects dared to rise against her one year ago. Her family was killed, but Isareth escaped into the catacombs of the city. Now she rules over a different realm, the realm of the dead, and her subjects obey her every whim.
